similarity.instructions: How similar is the candidate job to the target job in role focus and day-to-day tasks?
criteria: only the most basic tools or duties overlap
some overlap, but the jobs are significantly different
partial overlap of the key tasks
most key tasks match, with one major difference
nearly identical in both focus and tasks

grounded.instructions: Is this feedback comment a genuine issue or observation that the letter text and quoted span actually support? Answer no when the comment invents a problem, contradicts the letter, or is not about the text it cites.
